sloka: पृष्ठतो लक्ष्मण च एनम् अन्वगच्चत् समाहितः ।सज़रम् चापम् उद्यम्य सुमहद् विक्रमे रतः ।। ६-३८-९।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭhato lakṣmaṇa ca enam anvagaccat samāhitaḥ ।saja़ram cāpam udyamya sumahad vikrame rataḥ ।। 6-38-9।।

translations.english: Heroic and alert Lakshmana also holding his great bow, followed. His ministers and Vibheeshana and Sugriva also followed him up.
